note: Landmarks built by hand (scripts/world/landmarks.gd) at their real spots, measured off the 2019 USGS lidar (game x/z, meters). The lidar's own buildings and trees inside each `clear` rectangle are left out: the landmark stands there instead. A rectangle is [x0, z0, x1, z1] square to the compass, or [x, z, half_x, half_z, yaw]: centered on (x, z) and turned by yaw (radians, like Godot's rotation.y) with the building. tools/bake_lidar.py --yards counts the rectangles as buildings, so the corn and fences keep their distance.
